newsitem.title: MALTA: Malta cost of living rises slightly.
newsitem.headline: Malta cost of living rises slightly.

text.p: Malta's retail price index rose by 0.17 points to 103.69 points, up 0.16 percent, in February compared with January, the Central Office of Statistics said on Monday. The base rate is 1995:100.
The food index fell 0.30 points, while transport and communications rose 0.90 points, mainly due to an increase in car licence fees, Gozo ferry fares and mail charges.
There was also a rise of 1.06 points in the personal care and health index, and one of 0.45 points in education.
Inflation in February, calculated on a 12 month moving average, was 2.70 per cent from 2.65 in January.
